g.text: The blocks of the N4 merge with an empty sibling
every node reads the config, a take
and a fired waiter of each family
: payer 0 touches its priority queue space
: payer 0 creates a priority queue space
The chains of the main parent never enter
a merge. With E as the main parent, the
merge applies the deploys of C1 to C8 to
the post-state of E, so the merge of the
space branch is not vacuous. Every node
validates M and each touch block.
space block. Each space has one payer,
and the two payers alternate. On the
merged base, a merge keeps the
sequential offers of one payer in one
only the spaces that it created.
main parent: the merge starts from its post-state
